messages:
maria: Kicking off planning thread for the joint webinar with Nimbus Hardware + CloudMarketplace on May 12. Need speakers, demo plan, and swag logistics. TL;DR: 30-40m fireside + 20m hands-on demo. Who's owning what?

tyler: I can run demo engineering and the runbook. Need a test model and a small dataset. Prefer Dedicated with 2xA10s for live infer — Nimbus OK with that?

jenna: I'll own speaker coordination. Proposed speakers: Redwood: Maria (product) + Tyler (eng). Nimbus: Priya (HW lead) + Alex (solutions). All good?

sandeep: For the marketplace announcement — need to sync with marketplace team. We need a signed joint press blurb by EOD next Friday. @jenna can you loop in legal?

jenna: Yep, looping legal now. @evan can you draft the blurb copy? I have a short template.

evan: First pass drafted and uploaded: https://docs.google.com/xxxx — kept the marketplace callout compact. Please comment.

kelsey (Swag Ops): Swag checklist & counts: 150 tees (unisex S-XL), 200 stickers, 50 demo USBs, 20 co-branded jackets. Shipping deadline to venue: May 10 COB.

maria: Budget approved for swag but trim jackets to 10. Also add a promo card for Marketplace trial (QR + code).

tyler: Live demo run: 1) quick intro, 2) two sample prompts (low-latency vs batch), 3) show Console cost/latency dashboard, 4) simulate failover to quantized model. I'll create scripts + a disaster recovery script.

jenna: Need speaker bios + headshots by Apr 28. Priya asked for rehearsal slots — can we dry-run a week before?

maria: Target rehearsal: May 5, 10:00am PT. 30m slide sync + 45m full run. Mark calendars.

sandeep: Marketplace listing must be live 48h before the webinar so slides/screenshots can point to it. Ops, can we target May 10 morning for listing go-live?

evan: I'll coordinate with marketplace eng — tentatively yes, but need onboarding artifacts (helm chart or image link). @tyler can you provide demo artifacts by Apr 26?

tyler: I'll upload demo artifacts to the repo by Apr 25 — lightweight docker + runbook included.

kelsey (Swag Ops): Shipping plan: Redwood -> Nimbus staging -> venue. Need venue contact name to schedule delivery. @jenna can you get that today?

jenna: Got venue contact (Olivia). I'll DM Olivia and paste contact details here once confirmed.

deploy-bot: reminder: schedule webinar landing page deploy for May 3 09:00 PT

maria: AV checklist: HDMI + backup USB-C dongle, ethernet, stage laptop image with Dedicated creds, wired fallback. @tyler please prepare an offline demo snapshot if cloud is down.

tyler: Will prepare a canned recording + local demo using quantized weights for offline failover. We'll rehearse the failover step in dry-run.

jenna: Partner talking points: keep CTAs tight — marketplace listing + trial promo code. Avoid deep infra details on stage; have technical follow-up doc ready.

maria: Action item recap:
- jenna: speakers, bios, headshots, venue contact
- tyler: demo artifacts, failover recording, runbook
- evan: marketplace blurb + listing coordination
- sandeep: legal sign-off + joint press
- kelsey: swag order + shipping schedule (jackets trimmed)

maria: I'll create a pre-dry-run checklist doc and share the link by EOD tomorrow.

jenna: Thanks — rehearsal calendar invites sent.

kelsey (Swag Ops): Ordered stickers/tees/USBs today; jackets reduced to 10. Shipment tracking: UPS 1Z999AA10123456784 ETA May 9.

maria: Great. Next sync in 1 week. :party_parrot:
